plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: An issue spec to a reviewed PR by deliberate handoff, and the way epics are run cheaply: a role table with explicit models, a cost ledger, hooks that stop resumed and unnamed agents, and a retro that improves the plugin through reviewed PRs. Never merges a single issue; an epic merges only through the project gate.

description: Delivery workflow for GitHub-backed projects: issue spec, failing tests, implementation, review, handed back unmerged.
